prompt.text:
Implement a deterministic encoder for an assembly layout in package solution using only the standard library.

Export:
- type Segment struct { Code string; Span int }
- type Layout struct { Material string; Capacity, Gap int; Segments []Segment; Marks []int }
- func EncodeLayout(layout Layout) (string, error)

Material and every segment Code must be non-empty. Capacity, Gap, segment spans, and marks must be non-negative; spans must be positive. Marks may not exceed Capacity. Consumed span is the sum of segment spans plus Gap between adjacent segments only. Reject a layout whose consumed span exceeds Capacity. Preserve segment and mark order and do not mutate input slices. Return exactly this format, including final newline:
LAYOUT/1
[base]
material=<value>
capacity=<value>
[segments]
<code>:<span> (one per segment)
[marks]
<mark> (one per mark)
[totals]
used=<value>
remaining=<value>
Empty segment and mark lists produce their headers followed immediately by the next section.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
